description: This PHP class 'InterestAndPrincipal' calculates interest and principal amounts for a financial cash flow within a specific period, based on parameters such as interest rate, number of periods, present and future values, and payment type.

classes.name: InterestAndPrincipal
classes.description: A class representing the interest and principal components of a cash flow during a specific period in a financial calculation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that calculates interest and principal values for a given period based on financial parameters.

methods.name: interest
methods.description: Returns the calculated interest for the period.

methods.name: principal
methods.description: Returns the calculated principal for the period.
